name: Dinelco Payment
headline: Accept payments in Paraguay through Dinelco's secure checkout
overview: Enable your Paraguay store to accept Dinelco payments directly at VTEX checkout. Embedded iframe experience keeps customers on your store, with PYG currency support and real-time payment confirmation.
features: Secure payment processing through Dinelco's checkout platform
Native support for Paraguayan Guaraní (PYG) currency
Embedded iframe checkout — customers never leave your store
Real-time payment status updates via Dinelco callback
Automatic payment void for abandoned sessions
additionalInformation: Requires a valid Dinelco merchant account and API credentials. Contact Dinelco or Bepsa to obtain your Dinelco Secret key. This integration is intended for merchants operating in Paraguay.
